results.description:
# How much do vet nurses get paid?
WRITTEN BY:

A qualified veterinary nurse in Australia earns a minimum of $30.68 per hour if employed permanently under the Animal Care and Veterinary Services Award. Many clinics will pay above this award rate.

- $30.68 per hour, for regular hours
- $1165.70 per week (full time 38 hour week, before tax)

## FAQ
#### How much does a qualified vet nurse earn per hour in Australia?
The minimum rate is $30.68 per hour for permanent employees.
